title: Taiwanese Association of Madison-WI 威斯康星州麥城台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of Madison-WI (威斯康星州麥城台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations across the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese and Taiwanese American community in and around Madison, Wisconsin, and is listed under the TAA’s Midwest region (美中西).
